document.about: OMB, Analytical Perspectives FY 2027, chapter 10, Tax Expenditures (public domain): table rows whose dot leaders are mapped to U+FFFD.

notes: A leader's glyph is a small round mark on the baseline, read as the full stop it is.

2026-11-25 (#270): on a page of the tax-expenditure table, `Total` is set across the year columns over `2025 | 2026 | … | 2026–2035`. The span the ruling leaves open runs on over the stub's columns, empty there, and the years were read as a row of data under the label.

checks.issue: 415 text lines held runs of U+FFFD where the leaders are.

checks.text: Exclusion of certain allowances for Federal employees abroad .....

checks.issue: #270: each year column was named by the spanning label alone, the years a row of data.
